items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Well, the Baptist has the same rhythm, and the style of singing is on the blue side.

ctx.x: Well, people like Bud Scott and Mutt Carey, I know, told me years ago, and other people too, they even thought some of the early dance music, the jazz bands, were influenced by the music they heard in the churches.
Well, the Baptist has the same rhythm, and the style of singing is on the blue side.
